connector.name: OpsConduit Jobber MCP
connector.registryDescription: Customer-hosted read-only MCP server for Jobber ops reports, OAuth setup, and GraphQL validation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package jobber-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the opsconduit account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: JOBBER_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Jobber developer app client id for customer-owned OAuth setup.

env.name: JOBBER_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Jobber developer app client secret. Keep local; do not email or publish.

env.name: JOBBER_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: OAuth redirect URI, usually http://localhost:3333/oauth/callback for local setup.
